notes:
## Changes

- **Studios are named from file names.** When a refresh or import finds a new video whose file name holds one of your studios' names, that studio is named on the scene for you.
  - Spaces and punctuation don't matter: *northlight.films.scene*, *NorthlightFilms - Scene* and *Northlight_Films* all count for Northlight Films.
  - Only whole words count, so a short name isn't found inside a longer word.
  - Scenes already in your collection aren't changed. You can turn it off in Settings.
